ns2:course.label: Multivariate Analysis
ns2:course.description: Inference in multivariate statistical populations emphasizing the multivariate normal distribution; derivation of tests, estimates, and sampling distributions; and examples from the natural and social sciences. Prerequisite: STAT 410 and MATH 415, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: STAT 410 and MATH 415, or consent of instructor.
